title: Cross-Validation: What Does It Estimate and How Well Does It Do It?
venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
mechanism: Naive CV CIs under-cover because fold errors are correlated; nested CV estimates the variance with near-nominal coverage.
adaptation: Use as a correction factor for naive SEs of grouped-CV deltas; full nested CV too costly for deep nets.
min_experiment: Arm: compare naive CV SE with spread of deltas across 2 groupings. Kill: ratio < 1.2 means no correction.
evidence: R: theory and simulations on linear models show naive CV intervals under-cover.
